C-RU-TERMS-AND-RECORDS.Summary: Apply the owner's revised Russian term decisions across the Russian charter and portal, and align and rewrite the Russian Registry and Portfolio against their English sources in the same style.

Goals.Goal: Initiative is Russian again («инициатива», «паспорт инициативы», «постоянная инициатива», «структура инициатив»); Work Item is «задача»; workflow and value stream stay Latin (value stream explained at first use); all with correct agreement.

Every Russian Registry and Portfolio file is compared with its English source sentence by sentence, drift fixed, and rewritten under the style sheet (C-RU-NATURAL-ALIGNMENT/STYLE.md, revised 5 October 2026), keeping record identities, dates, decisions and states.

Constraints.Constraint: Authority: owner decisions of 5 October 2026; approvals and decision records not required during pre-production tuning.
English Registry and Portfolio are not changed by this bundle (C-BOARD-REPORTING-CLARITY may change the C-07 rows).
Structure rules of the style sheet apply; the build validates record identifiers and ISO dates in Registry and Portfolio translations.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: No «Initiative», «паспорт Initiative», «рабочий элемент», «рабочий процесс» in the workflow sense, or «поток создания ценности» as the replacement term remains in Russian sources.
All Registry and Portfolio Russian files pass the per-file checker; source, unit, scaffolding and site checks pass.
